title: Normalize Cad Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize cad/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract: rename CadApp -> CadPlayApp (app id "cad-play"), adopt SDK PanelKit/Terminology/Testkit primitives from semio_framework_plugin (framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs) replacing local tree_item/labels/testkit scaffolding, fix region markers/order (rename registration region to Manifest if needed, tests region to Tests), verify resource_kind("3d.cad") declaration is present, single-app crate stays flat (no wrapping mod). Scope: cad/plugin/rs/** only.
summary: Normalized cad/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract. C1: renamed CadApp -> CadPlayApp everywhere (struct, impl, region marker, manifest macro, all ~15 test call sites) since the app id is "cad-play". C2/C3: registration region was already named 🔖Manifest and tests region already 🧪Tests; fixed region ORDER by moving 🔖CommandLabels to sit between Terminology and Panels (was previously after the App impl), matching the canonical Constants->Types->DocumentHelpers->Terminology->CommandLabels->Panels->Render->AppImpl->Manifest->Tests order. C4: single-app crate, left flat (no wrapping mod) - correct per contract. C5 SDK adoption: (1) PanelKit - deleted the crate's full hand-rolled UiTreeItemNode-struct-literal tree_item_with_action; build_document_tree/build_catalogue_tree now built on semio_framework_plugin::PanelTreeBuilder (.section/.section_or_placeholder/.selected/.highlighted/.build()), keeping all id-string formats and business logic identical (verified via existing tests that assert exact id prefixes/labels). Kept a small app-specific cad_tree_item(id,label,icon_id,action) wrapper on top of the SDK's bare tree_item, since cad's items carry an icon rather than the SDK tree_item_with_action's description slot. mesh_selection_ids now wraps the SDK's selection_ids core extraction plus cad's own empty-fallback addition. (2) Terminology - cad_labels()'s locale check now reuses is_de_locale instead of a duplicated starts_with("de") check; app_labels() rewritten on AppLabelsOverlayExt's fluent builder (.window_kind_label/.mode_label/.action_labels/.utility_labels/.example_labels) instead of a hand-built AppLabelsOverlay struct literal; cad_action_labels/cad_utility_labels rewritten on localized_label_map. CadLabels itself (struct + EN/DE/reuse consts + resolver) stays hand-rolled: it is locale x terminology (native/reuse) two-dimensional, which does not fit app_labels!/LocaleLabels (locale-only, one struct per resolution) - flagged for Wave-4 audit. (3) Testkit - local meta()/new_app() test helpers now delegate to semio_framework_plugin::testkit::meta/testkit::new_app::<CadPlayApp>() (call sites unchanged, ~30 usages). Replaced the one test that is an exact match for the generic shape (undo_redo_round_trips_added_object_through_wrapper) with testkit::assert_undo_redo_round_trip. Left three richer tests untouched and app-unique: undo_redo_round_trips_added_node_through_wrapper (asserts an extra history-changed event), two_instances_converge_disjoint_edits_via_backbone (needs a shared pre-loaded base document with existing object ids before diverging, which testkit's paired_apps - fresh A::default() on both sides - can't express), and ingest_operations_is_idempotent_for_cad (asserts both that ops actually flowed onto the channel AND the exact resulting count, stronger than testkit's self-referential once-vs-twice equality check). resource_kind("3d.cad") was already present on the AppBuilder chain from a prior Wave-1 pass - verified, untouched. Region order after the pass: Constants, BrepMeshes, Document, PaneHelpers, Gumball, Terminology, CommandLabels, Panels, CadPlayApp, Manifest, Tests.
